resources.title: Everything You Need to Know About 0.4 in 18 Minutes
resources.creator: Zizaran
resources.noteEs: Zizaran condensa todo el patch 0.4 (Last of the Druids) en 18 minutos: nueva ascendencia Druid, mecánica de liga Fate of the Vaal, ajustes de balance y endgame. Anchor de mechanics-per-league para los players que arrancan PoE 2 cada nueva temporada.
resources.noteEn: Zizaran condenses the entire 0.4 patch (Last of the Druids) into 18 minutes: new Druid ascendancy, Fate of the Vaal league mechanic, balance adjustments, and endgame changes. Anchor for mechanics-per-league for players entering PoE 2 each new season.

resources.title: PoE 2 0.4 — The Most Important Tip for League Start
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: Lolcohol enfoca un solo punto crítico para el league start de 0.4: cómo aprovechar la nueva mecánica desde el campaña sin desperdiciar runs. Más conciso que el overview de Zizaran, complementario para players que ya leyeron lo principal y quieren la jugada práctica del día 1.
resources.noteEn: Lolcohol focuses on a single critical point for the 0.4 league start: how to leverage the new mechanic from campaign onward without wasting runs. More concise than Zizaran's overview, complementary for players who've read the main coverage and want the practical day-1 play.
